title: Windows 11 Error
blurb: Windows errors used to shout. This one clears its throat. Windows 11 continued the long softening of Microsoft's alert design, replacing the panicky ding of the XP years with something rounded and almost apologetic, so that being told you cannot do a thing now feels more like a polite suggestion. It is recognisable within a single note to anyone on a modern PC, which is exactly why it works dropped into an edit at the moment somebody does something obviously, avoidably wrong. Free MP3 for your next fail compilation.
origin: The system error sound from Windows 11.
